text:
Maya (Prod Mktg): Quick check — we need to lock a webinar topic and run-of-show by EOD. Picking between 'Practical inference economics' and 'Scaling inference for product teams'.
Sam - Events: I vote Practical inference economics — resonates with customers lately. shorter title maybe 'Practical Inference Economics: Cost, Latency, and Tradeoffs'
Julian (Content): Agree on Practical. We can angle with 3 customer stories + 1 live demo. Need a tightening of the abstract.
Nina - Speaker Ops: Speakers? @Alexa can do product narrative, @Julian can moderate, we should get someone from infra (ops) for the demo. I can ping a couple of folks.
Alexa (Growth): I can lead the product talk. Prefer a 20m talk + 10m demo + 15m panel + 15m Q&A.
Maya (Prod Mktg): Sounds good. Can we sketch a 60m run-of-show now and a rehearsal plan? Also need messaging checklist for the launch post and social snippets.
Sam - Events: Draft run-of-show below — share edits:
```
00:00 - 00:05  Greenroom/Intro (host welcome, tech checks)
00:05 - 00:25  Product talk: Economics framework (Alexa)
00:25 - 00:35  Live demo: cost/latency tradeoffs (Infra engineer)
00:35 - 00:50  Panel: customer stories + best practices (Julian moderates)
00:50 - 01:00  Live Q&A + CTA (signup, eval kit)
```
Julian (Content): For the abstract draft — keeping short form:
"Ship LLM features without breaking the bank. Join Redwood Inference to learn a practical framework for balancing cost, latency, and quality — with real customer examples and a live demo of cost-saving tactics that don't degrade UX."
Alexa (Growth): Love it. For social snippets we need 3 angles: 1) Engineering-focused (benchmarks + subtle CTA), 2) Exec-focused (TCO and SLA talk), 3) Product-focused (how to ship features faster). I'll draft.
Nina - Speaker Ops: Proposed speakers: Alexa (product), Priya (infra engineer, demo), Mateo (customer - ecom), Sara (customer - docs automation). I will confirm availability and get bios.
ops-bot: Reminder — book studio and test link 24h before start.
Maya (Prod Mktg): Rehearsal plan: one tech check 48h prior (all presenters + ops), full dress rehearsal 4h before event with run timing, slides, and demo failover. Assign someone to watch the chat and surface top Qs to moderator.
Sam - Events: Can we include an emergency fallback for demo? e.g., pre-recorded demo + sandbox link.
Julian (Content): Yes — record the demo flow `demo-recording-v1.mp4` and host fallback on S3. Also capture a short snippet for Twitter.
Alexa (Growth): CTA ideas: 1) Signup for eval credits, 2) Download cost-playbook, 3) Book a dedicated capacity consult. Which one do we prioritize?
Maya (Prod Mktg): Primary CTA = eval credits. Secondary = cost-playbook. Landing page + tracking params needed. @Sam please create the event page and add UTM params: `utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=inference_econ_2025`.
Sam - Events: On it — will have a draft event page by tomorrow noon.
Nina - Speaker Ops: I'll schedule rehearsals and share calendar invites. Need speaker slides by 72h before event.
Julian (Content): I'll prepare 3 pull quotes and 5 tweet-sized lines for promotion.
Alexa (Growth): Can someone make a short benchmark graphic (cost/token comparisons) for the slide deck and social? Might need help from eng-ml.
Maya (Prod Mktg): @Julian please coordinate with eng-ml for the graphic. Also compile a short FAQ for the moderator.
ops-bot: Action created: Book studio (task #45321). Assigned to Sam - Events. Due: 1768460000.
Sam - Events: Thanks — will confirm studio and send test link.
Maya (Prod Mktg): OK — next steps assigned. We'll reconvene here after speaker confirmations. If anyone has objections to the run-of-show, flag now. :thumbsup:
Alexa (Growth): :thumbsup:
Julian (Content): +1
Nina - Speaker Ops: +1, will post speaker confirmations in thread when done.
Maya (Prod Mktg): End of thread — capturing notes to the planning doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE (will replace with real link).
